setup.title: Initialize this deployment

setup.partialHelp: Only one required data document exists. Setup will not overwrite it; repair or clear the partial state explicitly.
setup.unsupportedHelp: The selected data repository does not provide the initialization capability.
setup.secretMissingHelp: Add a NAMI_SECRET of at least 32 characters to the WebUI deployment and reload this page.
